name: ColdSire
description: Premium cold-email inbox infrastructure — Google/Microsoft mailboxes from a pool mixed with real businesses, ~$6/mo per account, pitched at deliverability.

mentions.evidence: ~$15.6k MRR, 909 active subscriptions, ~$15.3k L30, ~$1.04M all-time, ~5,000 users claimed, founded May 2023, US. Last sync Oct 1, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Sell the boring dependency under a hot category (cold email) — inboxes, domains, warming — not another AI writer.

whyItPrints: Outbound teams don't want to babysit Google bans. Selling mailboxes as infra is unsexy and recurring; ~900 subs and $1M+ all-time say the pain is real (ethics/compliance vary by buyer — note the grey-hat adjacency).
